questions.text: The feature lists six configuration areas (departments, packages, rate lists, staff, branding, operational settings). Should this single requirement cover all six, or only a subset (and which)? The rest would become separate requirements.
What are the 'operational settings' a Hospital Admin can configure (e.g. working hours, notification/SMS recipients, gate rules, EDD defaults)? Please list the fields.

Rate lists: the blueprint mentions 2 rate lists and 4 delivery categories with package caps. Should the Hospital Admin be able to create/edit both lists and the caps, and are edits versioned or effective-dated?
questions.answer: They should be able to edit all the rate lists and 4 delivery categories, edit will be effective immediately

questions.text: Staff: should this requirement include creating users and assigning roles (blueprint says Identity Service does not create users; Hospital Admin does), and which roles are assignable?
questions.answer: That was a mistake, identity service can create users

questions.text: Branding: what is configurable (logo, name, colours, receipt header/footer) and are there file size/format limits?
Can configuration be edited before Super Admin ratifies the hospital's onboarding, or only once the tenant is active?
questions.answer: only once the tenant is active

questions.text: This requirement needs both backend (config endpoints, tenant-active check, rate list/staff/branding storage) and frontend (admin configuration screens). Should it be split into two work items (api and web-ui, as was done for hospital self-onboarding), or a single work item on one app? If one, which?
Departments and packages: what fields does each have (e.g. department name/code/active flag; package name, included services, cap amount)? Are packages tied to a delivery category?

Staff: the Identity Service can create users. Should the config API call the Identity Service to create users, and should staff be deactivatable/deletable, or only created and role-assigned? Is a temporary password or an invite email used?
Branding: where are logos stored (S3 as in the onboarding certificate upload?) and what file types and max size should we enforce, given the requirement left limits unspecified?

Working hours: one schedule for the whole hospital, or per department? Which format (per weekday open/close, closed days)? Is it informational only, or does it restrict any behaviour (e.g. registration, gate actions)?

Rate lists: are the 2 rate lists and 4 delivery categories fixed system entities that only have their rates/caps edited, or can the admin add or remove lists and categories? Should edits be audit-logged even though they are not versioned?
